findings.claim: Add E2E coverage for the missing-package guidance. This install hint is user-facing, so keep it covered by a CLI regression in the E2E suite.

`warnOnVersionSkew` loses the prod/dev split, so its alignment command misclassifies `stash`. `skewed.map(({ pkg }) => pinnedSpec(pkg))` is passed as the *prod* argument to `combinedInstallCommands` with `[]` for dev, regardless of package role.
Print alignment commands when missing packages and skew coexist non-interactively. This path installs only missing packages, but never displays `alignCommands`.

Verify all first-party packages in the manual-install guidance. Checking only `@cipherstash/stack` does not detect skew in the integration adapter (affects skills/stash-drizzle/SKILL.md and skills/stash-supabase/SKILL.md).

findings.severity_label: outside diff range | 🎯 Functional Correctness | 🟠 Major | ⚡ Quick win
findings.claim: Do not report success while alignment failed or skew remains. An alignment command can fail while every package remains present at its old version.
